decisions.evidence: Overall, the direct structural alerts from nitro (1) and N-oxide (1), together with the low QED drug-likeness of 0.2424 and the fully unsaturated scaffold with fraction of sp3 carbons 0, outweigh the more modest exposure-related and charge-related features, so the molecule is predicted to be mutagenic (B).
the overall comparison supports option (B): is mutagenic.
